# The original Calendar icon srcset appends another query delimiter

The original item appends ?size directly to each moz-icon source, including a source that can already contain query text. Its test only exercises a query-free dummy source. Accepted code delegates to makeMozIconSrcSet, whose query helper chooses & for an existing query and whose output escapes srcset separators. Keep this later repair separate from the original URI utility and item tests; no rendered icon failure was reproduced.

Scope: Calendar attachment icon query and receiver contract.
